title: sss_pipeline: provenance-linked, segment-indexed side-scan sonar data model (reference implementation)
description: Reference implementation of a provenance-linked, segment-level data model for side-scan sonar (XTF) data: compatibility-aware ingestion with recorded repair, ISO 19115/19139 and SSS companion metadata, acquisition-aware segment index (GeoJSON), preview strips, locally stitched product variants, descriptive metrics, and an interactive viewer. Includes run records and derived results for MGDS data sets NBP0505 (doi:10.1594/IEDA/306159) and NBP1001 (doi:10.1594/IEDA/316265). The Chonburi survey used in the paper is available from the corresponding author on request.
